38: function build_board()
39: {
40:   echo -e "Build command line:"
41:   echo -e "  ${TOOLSDIR}/configure.sh -e $1"
42:   echo -e "  make -C ${NUTTXDIR} EXTRAFLAGS="$EXTRA_FLAGS" ${@:2}"
43:   echo -e "  make -C ${NUTTXDIR} savedefconfig"
44: 
45:   KCONFIG_ARGS="--enable-mconf --disable-nconf --disable-gconf --disable-qconf"
46:   if [ `uname` == "Darwin" ]; then
47:     KCONFIG_ARGS+=" --disable-shared --enable-static"
48:   fi
49: 
50:   if [ ! -f "${ROOTDIR}/prebuilts/kconfig-frontends/bin/kconfig-conf" ] &&
51:      [ ! -x "$(command -v kconfig-conf)" ]; then
52:     pushd ${ROOTDIR}/prebuilts/kconfig-frontends
53:     ./configure --prefix=${ROOTDIR}/prebuilts/kconfig-frontends ${KCONFIG_ARGS} 1>/dev/null
54:     touch aclocal.m4 Makefile.in
55:     make install 1>/dev/null
56:     popd
57:   fi
58:   export PATH=${ROOTDIR}/prebuilts/kconfig-frontends/bin:$PATH
59: 
60:   if ! ${TOOLSDIR}/configure.sh -e $1; then
61:     echo "Error: ############# config ${1} fail ##############"
62:     exit 1
63:   fi
64: 
65:   if [[ ${CUSTOM_COMPILER} == "tasking" ]]; then
66:     kconfig-tweak --file ${NUTTXDIR}/.config --enable CONFIG_TRICORE_TOOLCHAIN_TASKING
67:   fi
68: 
69:   GHS_OPTS_STRING="CONFIG_ARCH_TOOLCHAIN_GHS=y"
70:   TASKING_OPTS_STRING="CONFIG_TRICORE_TOOLCHAIN_TASKING=y"
71:   if grep -qE "^(${GHS_OPTS_STRING}|${TASKING_OPTS_STRING})$" "${NUTTXDIR}/.config"; then
72:     echo "EXTRA_FLAGS are required to update the when using the GHS or Tasking toolchain."
73:     EXTRA_FLAGS=$(echo "$EXTRA_FLAGS" | sed 's/-Wno-cpp//' | xargs)
74:   fi
75: 
76:   if ! ${BEAR} make -C ${NUTTXDIR} EXTRAFLAGS="$EXTRA_FLAGS" ${@:2}; then
77:     echo "Error: ############# build ${1} fail ##############"
78:     exit 2
79:   else
80:     if [ -f "${COMPILE_COMMANDS}" ]; then
81:       cp ${COMPILE_COMMANDS} ${COMPILE_COMMANDS_BACKUP}
82:     fi
83:   fi
84: 
85:   if echo "${@:2}" | grep -q "distclean"; then
86:     if [ -f "${COMPILE_COMMANDS}" ]; then
87:       rm -rf ${COMPILE_COMMANDS}
88:     fi
89:     return;
90:   fi

92:   if ! make -C ${NUTTXDIR} savedefconfig; then
93:     echo "Error: ############# save ${1} fail ##############"
94:     exit 3
95:   fi
96: 
97:   if [ ! -d $1 ]; then
98:     cp ${NUTTXDIR}/defconfig ${ROOTDIR}/nuttx/boards/*/*/${1/[:|\/]//configs/}
99:   else
100:     if grep -q "#include" "$1/defconfig"; then
101:       echo "Note: skipping savedefconfig for debug defconfig."
102:     else
103:       cp ${NUTTXDIR}/defconfig $1
104:     fi
105:   fi
106: }

108: function build_board_cmake()
109: {
110:   # first check if the command target is `distclean`
111:   # cmake is built for out-of-tree, so delete the CMAKE_BINARY_DIR directory directly
112:   if echo "${@:2}" | grep -q "distclean"; then
113:     echo -e "Build target distclean:"
114:     echo -e "  there is no need to distclean in cmake, delete '${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}' directly"
115:     if [ -d "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}" ]; then
116:       rm -rf $CMAKE_BINARY_DIR
117:     fi
118:     return 0
119:   fi
120:   # check parallelism
121:   j_arg=$(echo ${@:2} |grep -oP '\-j[0-9]+')
122:   # cmake verbose
123:   v_arg=""
124: 
125:   # remove the -Wno-cpp build option from ghs build options
126:   GHS_OPTS_STRING="CONFIG_ARM_TOOLCHAIN_GHS=y"
127:   TASKING_OPTS_STRING="CONFIG_TRICORE_TOOLCHAIN_TASKING=y"
128:   defconfig_path=$1/defconfig
129:   valid_defconfig_path=$(echo ${defconfig_path} | sed 's/^.\{3\}//')
130:   if grep -qE "^(${GHS_OPTS_STRING}|${TASKING_OPTS_STRING})$" "${valid_defconfig_path}"; then
131:     echo "EXTRA_FLAGS are required to update the when using the GHS toolchain."
132:     EXTRA_FLAGS=$(echo "$EXTRA_FLAGS" | sed 's/-Wno-cpp//' | xargs)
133:   fi
134:   export VELA_EXTRA_FLAGS="$EXTRA_FLAGS"
135:   # let use lunch directily
136:   echo " lunch $1 ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR} "
137:   lunch $1 ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}
138:   echo
139:   # check if the command target is `Xconfig`
140:   for arg in "${@:2}"
141:   do
142:     if [[ $arg == *config ]]; then
143:       if ! m $arg; then
144:         echo "Error: #############  m $arg fail ##############"
145:         exit 2
146:       else
147:         return 0
148:       fi
149:     fi
150:     if [[ "$arg" =~ ^V=1$ ]]; then
151:       v_arg+="V=1"
152:     fi
153:   done
154:   # do cmake build
155:   if ! m $j_arg $v_arg; then
156:     echo "Error: ############# build ${1} fail ##############"
157:     exit 2
158:   fi
159: }

162: function setup_cmake_binary_dir()
163: {
164:   local boardconfig=$1
165:   if [ -d ${ROOTDIR}/${boardconfig} ]; then
166:     # parse path config
167:     config_name=$(basename "$boardconfig")
168:     board_name=$(basename $(dirname $(dirname "$boardconfig")))
169:   else
170:     # parse nuttx config pair
171:     config_name=`echo ${boardconfig} | cut -s -d':' -f2`
172:     if [ -z "${config_name}" ]; then
173:       board_name=`echo ${boardconfig} | cut -d'/' -f1`
174:       config_name=`echo ${boardconfig} | cut -d'/' -f2`
175:     else
176:       board_name=`echo ${boardconfig} | cut -d':' -f1`
177:     fi
178:   fi
179:   CMAKE_BINARY_DIR+="/${board_name}_${config_name}"
180: }
181: 
182: if [ $# == 0 ]; then
183:   echo "Usage: $0 [-m] <board-name>:<config-name> [-e <extraflags>] [--cmake] [-b <cmake_binary_dir>] [--dis-ninja] [make options]"
184:   echo ""
185:   echo "Where:"
186:   echo "  -m: out of tree build. Or default in tree build without it."
187:   echo "  -e: pass extra c/c++ flags such as -Werror via make command line"
188:   echo "  --cmake: switch the build mode to CMake compilation."
189:   echo "  -b: set custom binary directory for CMake."
190:   echo "  --dis-ninja: disable CMake Ninja generator fo default."
191:   echo "  -c: set custom toolchain."
192:   exit 1
193: fi
194: 
195: ROOTDIR=$(dirname $(readlink -f ${0}))
196: ROOTDIR=$(realpath ${ROOTDIR}/../..)
197: 
198: CONFIGPATH=$2
199: 
200: if [ $1 == "-m" ]; then
201:   # out of tree build
202:   confparams=(${CONFIGPATH//:/ })
203:   configdir=${confparams[1]}
204: 
205:   if [ -z "${configdir}" ]; then
206:     # handle cases where the end is a "/"
207:     if [ "${CONFIGPATH:(-1)}" = "/" ]; then
208:       CONFIGPATH=${CONFIGPATH:0:-1}
209:     fi
210:     boarddir=`echo ${CONFIGPATH} | rev | cut -d'/' -f3 | rev`
211:     configdir=`echo ${CONFIGPATH} | rev | cut -d'/' -f1 | rev`
212:   else
213:     boarddir=${confparams[0]}
214:   fi
215: 
216:   OUTDIR=${ROOTDIR}/out/${boarddir}/${configdir}
217:   MOUNTDIR=${OUTDIR}/.unionfs
218:   NUTTXDIR=${MOUNTDIR}/nuttx
219: 
220:   trap cleanup EXIT
221:   mount_unionfs

1: # BK7258 最终固件构建步骤
2: 
3: 本文记录当前工作区已经验证通过的构建流程。最终固件由以下三部分组成：
4: 
5: ```text
6: OpenVela CPU1/AP nuttx.bin
7: Armino CPU0/CP app.bin
8: Beken bootloader.bin
9:         |
10:         v
11: Beken packager
12:         |
13:         v
14: all-app.bin
15: ```
16: 
17: OpenVela 只构建 AP raw binary。CP、bootloader、分区生成和最终打包均由
18: `bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab` 完成。不要手工覆盖打包目录中的 `app1.bin`，
19: 应使用已经接入的 `EXTERNAL_AP_BIN` 接口。
20: 
21: ## 1. 前置条件
22: 
23: 工作区路径：
24: 
25: ```text
26: /home/mi/vela_competition/contest
27: /home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp
28: ```
29: 
30: 确认官方 Armino 1.5 Podman 镜像存在：
31: 
32: ```bash
33: podman images
34: ```
35: 
36: 应包含：
37: 
38: ```text
39: localhost/bekencorp/armino-idk:1.5
40: ```
41: 
42: `app_ab` 使用自己的分区配置：
43: 
44: ```text
45: bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/partitions/bk7258/auto_partitions.csv
46: bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/partitions/bk7258/ram_regions.csv
47: ```
48: 
49: 不得混用 `bk_solution_ai` 等其他项目的分区文件。
50: 
51: ## 2. 构建 OpenVela AP
52: 
53: ```bash
54: cd /home/mi/vela_competition/contest
55: 
56: ./build.sh \
57:   vendor/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-ap/configs/nsh \
58:   -e -Werror \
59:   --cmake \
60:   -j8
61: ```
62: 
63: 如修改过 `Kconfig` 或 `defconfig`，建议先删除旧 CMake 配置：
64: 
65: ```bash
66: ./build.sh \
67:   vendor/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-ap/configs/nsh \
68:   --cmake distclean
69: ```
70: 
71: 实际输出：
72: 
73: ```text
74: contest/cmake_out/bk7258-ap_nsh/nuttx       # ELF
75: contest/cmake_out/bk7258-ap_nsh/nuttx.bin   # AP raw binary
76: contest/cmake_out/bk7258-ap_nsh/System.map
77: ```
78: 
79: 检查 AP 文件：
80: 
81: ```bash
82: stat -c '%s %y %n' cmake_out/bk7258-ap_nsh/nuttx.bin
83: sha256sum cmake_out/bk7258-ap_nsh/nuttx.bin
84: ```
85: 
86: AP 必须使用 Cortex-M33 hard-float 配置，链接地址必须与 `app_ab` 的 AP
87: 布局匹配，并且 `nuttx.bin` 不得超过 AP 分区容量。
88: 
89: ## 3. 准备外部 AP 输入
90: 
91: Podman 只挂载 `bk_avdk_smp`，因此先把 AP raw binary 复制到 SDK 内部：
92: 
93: ```bash
94: cp \
95:   /home/mi/vela_competition/contest/cmake_out/bk7258-ap_nsh/nuttx.bin \
96:   /home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/build/openvela-ap.bin
97: ```
98: 
99: 确认源文件和复制结果一致：
100: 
101: ```bash
102: sha256sum \
103:   /home/mi/vela_competition/contest/cmake_out/bk7258-ap_nsh/nuttx.bin \
104:   /home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/build/openvela-ap.bin
105: ```
106: 
107: ## 4. 构建 CP 并打包最终固件
108: 
109: 在 `bk_avdk_smp` 根目录执行：
110: 
111: ```bash
112: cd /home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp
113: 
114: podman run --rm \
115:   --userns=keep-id \
116:   -v "$PWD:/armino" \
117:   -w /armino \
118:   localhost/bekencorp/armino-idk:1.5 \
119:   make -C projects/app_ab bk7258 \
120:   SDK_DIR=/armino \
121:   EXTERNAL_AP_BIN=/armino/build/openvela-ap.bin
122: ```
123: 
124: 该命令自动完成：
125: 
126: 1. 生成 `app_ab` 分区文件。
127: 2. 构建 Armino CPU0/CP。
128: 3. 获取 Beken bootloader。
129: 4. 将 `EXTERNAL_AP_BIN` 复制为打包输入 `app1.bin`。
130: 5. 调用标准 Beken packager 生成最终固件。
131: 
132: 仅安装 Podman 时不要使用会在内部调用 Docker 的 `dbuild.sh`。
133: 
134: ## 5. 输出文件
135: 
136: 完整烧录固件：
137: 
138: ```text
139: /home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/package/all-app.bin
140: ```
141: 
142: OTA 固件：
143: 
144: ```text
145: /home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/package/app_ab_crc.rbl
146: ```
147: 
148: 最终打包输入：
149: 
150: ```text
151: package/tmp/bootloader.bin  # Beken bootloader
152: package/tmp/app.bin         # Armino CPU0/CP
153: package/tmp/app1.bin        # OpenVela CPU1/AP
154: ```
155: 
156: 实际完整路径的共同前缀为：
157: 
158: ```text
159: /home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/
160: ```
161: 
162: ## 6. 构建后校验
163: 
164: 首先确认最终文件存在：
165: 
166: ```bash
167: ls -lh \
168:   projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/package/all-app.bin \
169:   projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/package/app_ab_crc.rbl
170: ```
171: 
172: 然后确认 packager 使用了本次构建的 OpenVela AP：
173: 
174: ```bash
175: sha256sum \
176:   /home/mi/vela_competition/contest/cmake_out/bk7258-ap_nsh/nuttx.bin \
177:   build/openvela-ap.bin \
178:   projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/package/tmp/app1.bin
179: 
180: cmp -s \
181:   /home/mi/vela_competition/contest/cmake_out/bk7258-ap_nsh/nuttx.bin \
182:   projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/package/tmp/app1.bin
183: ```
184: 
185: 三个 SHA256 必须一致，`cmp` 必须返回 0。否则生成的 `all-app.bin` 可能仍包含旧 AP。
186: 
187: 检查分区和构建摘要：
188: 
189: ```bash
190: cat projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/partitions/bk_package.json
191: cat projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/package/build_summary.txt
192: ```
193: 
194: `bk_package.json` 应包含：
195: 
196: ```text
197: bootloader.bin -> bootloader
198: app.bin        -> CPU0/CP app
199: app1.bin       -> CPU1/AP app
200: ```
201: 
202: 注意：`build_summary.txt` 中的 AP memory info 来自构建过程中的 Armino AP
203: 占位镜像 map，不用于证明外部 OpenVela AP 已经打包。外部 AP 是否生效必须以
204: `nuttx.bin`、`build/openvela-ap.bin` 和 `package/tmp/app1.bin` 的哈希及
205: 逐字节比较为准。
206: 
207: ## 7. 常见问题
208: 
209: - OpenVela CMake 构建产物是 `nuttx.bin` 和 `System.map`，不是
210:   `vela_nuttx.bin` 或 `nuttx.map`。
211: - 当前 OpenVela 工作树是 `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest`，不是旧的
212:   `openvela_bk7258_dev`。
213: - `EXTERNAL_AP_BIN` 必须填写容器内路径
214:   `/armino/build/openvela-ap.bin`，不能填写宿主机绝对路径。
215: - 修改配置后若增量构建没有加载新配置，先执行 CMake `distclean`。
216: - 最终烧录文件名是 `all-app.bin`，不是 `all_app.bin`。

53: function compare_versions() {
54:     version1=$1
55:     version2=$2
56: 
57:     major1=$(echo $version1 | cut -d. -f1)
58:     minor1=$(echo $version1 | cut -d. -f2)
59:     major2=$(echo $version2 | cut -d. -f1)

70:             echo -1

81:         if [ $result -eq -1 ]; then

1: #!/bin/sh
2: 
3: set -eu
4: 
5: script_dir=$(dirname "$(readlink -f "$0")")
6: csv=${1:-$script_dir/../../../../external/bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/partitions/bk7258/ram_regions.csv}
7: generated=${2:-${BK7258_ARMINO_RAM_HEADER:-}}
8: header=$script_dir/hardware/bk7258_mbox.h
9: linker=$script_dir/../../boards/bk7258/bk7258-ap/scripts/ld.script
10: 
11: if [ ! -r "$csv" ]; then
12:   printf '%s\n' "BK7258 SWAP layout: cannot read $csv" >&2
13:   exit 1
14: fi
15: 
16: result=$(awk -F, '
17:   function hex(value, result, i, digit) {
18:     sub(/^0[xX]/, "", value)
19:     value = tolower(value)
20:     result = 0
21:     for (i = 1; i <= length(value); i++) {
22:       digit = index("0123456789abcdef", substr(value, i, 1)) - 1
23:       if (digit < 0) return -1
24:       result = result * 16 + digit
25:     }
26:     return result
27:   }
28:   BEGIN { base = hex("28000000"); found = 0 }
29:   /^[[:space:]]*#/ { next }
30:   /^[[:space:]]*PSRAM_CAPCAITY_SIZE/ { next }
31:   NF >= 4 {
32:     name = $1
33:     type = $2
34:     offset = $3
35:     size = $4
36:     gsub(/[[:space:]]/, "", name)
37:     gsub(/[[:space:]]/, "", type)
38:     gsub(/[[:space:]]/, "", offset)
39:     gsub(/[[:space:]]/, "", size)
40:     if (type != "SRAM") next
41:     if (offset != "") base = hex(offset)
42:     bytes = hex(size)
43:     if (name == "SWAP") {
44:       printf "0x%08x 0x%08x\n", base, bytes
45:       found = 1
46:     }
47:     base += bytes
48:   }
49:   END { if (!found) exit 2 }
50: ' "$csv")
51: 
52: header_result=$(awk '
53:   /#define[[:space:]]+BK7258_SWAP_BASE/ { gsub(/[uUlL]/, "", $3); base=tolower($3) }
54:   /#define[[:space:]]+BK7258_SWAP_SIZE/ { gsub(/[uUlL]/, "", $3); size=tolower($3) }
55:   END { print base, size }
56: ' "$header")
57: 
58: if [ "$header_result" != "$result" ]; then
59:   printf '%s\n' "BK7258 header SWAP mismatch: CSV=$result header=$header_result" >&2
60:   exit 1
61: fi
62: 
63: uart_result=$(awk '
64:   /#define[[:space:]]+BK7258_MB_UART_RX_ADDRESS/ { gsub(/[uUlL]/, "", $3); rx=tolower($3) }
65:   /#define[[:space:]]+BK7258_MB_UART_TX_ADDRESS/ { gsub(/[uUlL]/, "", $3); tx=tolower($3) }
66:   END { print rx, tx }
67: ' "$header")
68: expected_uart=$(awk -v layout="$result" '
69:   function hex(value, result, i, digit) {
70:     sub(/^0[xX]/, "", value)
71:     value = tolower(value)
72:     result = 0
73:     for (i = 1; i <= length(value); i++) {
74:       digit = index("0123456789abcdef", substr(value, i, 1)) - 1
75:       if (digit < 0) return -1
76:       result = result * 16 + digit
77:     }
78:     return result
79:   }
80:   BEGIN {
81:     split(layout, fields, " ")
82:     base = hex(fields[1])
83:     printf "0x%08x 0x%08x\n", base + 1024, base + 1280
84:   }
85: ')
86: if [ "$uart_result" != "$expected_uart" ]; then
87:   printf '%s\n' "BK7258 UART0 SWAP mismatch: expected=$expected_uart header=$uart_result" >&2
88:   exit 1
89: fi
90: 
91: linker_result=$(awk '
92:   /SWAP[[:space:]]+\(rw\)/ {
93:     for (i = 1; i <= NF; i++) {
94:       if ($i == "ORIGIN") base=$(i + 2)
95:       if ($i == "LENGTH") size=$(i + 2)
96:     }
97:     gsub(/,/, "", base)
98:     print tolower(base), tolower(size)
99:   }
100: ' "$linker")
101: 
102: if [ "$linker_result" != "$result" ]; then
103:   printf '%s\n' "BK7258 linker SWAP mismatch: CSV=$result linker=$linker_result" >&2
104:   exit 1
105: fi
106: 
107: if [ -n "$generated" ]; then
108:   if [ ! -r "$generated" ]; then
109:     printf '%s\n' "BK7258 generated RAM header unreadable: $generated" >&2
110:     exit 1
111:   fi
112: 
113:   generated_result=$(awk '
114:     /#define[[:space:]]+CONFIG_SWAP_ADDR/ { gsub(/[uUlL]/, "", $3); base=tolower($3) }
115:     /#define[[:space:]]+CONFIG_SWAP_SIZE/ { gsub(/[uUlL]/, "", $3); size=tolower($3) }
116:     END { print base, size }
117:   ' "$generated")
118:   if [ "$generated_result" != "$result" ]; then
119:     printf '%s\n' "BK7258 generated RAM header mismatch: CSV=$result generated=$generated_result" >&2
120:     exit 1
121:   fi
122: fi

100: ## 3. 正确构建链条
101: 
102: 最终固件链条固定为：
103: 
104: ```text
105: OpenVela nuttx.bin
106:   -> bk_avdk_smp/build/openvela-ap.bin
107:   -> EXTERNAL_AP_BIN
108:   -> package/tmp/app1.bin
109:   -> package/all-app.bin
110: 
111: Armino CP app.bin + Beken bootloader.bin
112:   ---------------------------------------> package/all-app.bin
113: ```
114: 
115: 修改以下任一输入后，不得直接做 SMP 增量构建：
116: 
117: - `ram_regions.csv`
118: - AP/CP `config`
119: - Kconfig 默认值
120: - 分区生成脚本
121: - SoC 链接脚本
122: 
123: 原因是顶层 `partitions/ram_regions.h` 可以先更新，而 AP/CP CMake 构建目录中的
124: `armino/partitions/_build/ram_regions.csv`、生成头和预处理链接脚本仍可能保留旧值。
125: 这会形成顶层 16 MiB、核内仍 8 MiB 的不一致产物。
126: 
127: 先构建 OpenVela AP，并将输入放到 SMP 工作树：
128: 
129: ```bash
130: cd ~/vela_competition/contest
131: ./build.sh \
132:   vendor/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-ap/configs/nsh \
133:   -e -Werror --cmake -j8
134: 
135: cp \
136:   cmake_out/bk7258-ap_nsh/nuttx.bin \
137:   ~/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/build/openvela-ap.bin
138: ```
139: 
140: 然后执行项目级 clean 和容器内完整构建：
141: 
142: ```bash
143: cd ~/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp
144: make -C projects/app_ab clean
145: 
146: podman run --rm \
147:   --userns=keep-id \
148:   -v "$PWD:/armino" \
149:   -w /armino \
150:   localhost/bekencorp/armino-idk:1.5 \
151:   make -C projects/app_ab bk7258 \
152:   SDK_DIR=/armino \
153:   EXTERNAL_AP_BIN=/armino/build/openvela-ap.bin
154: ```
155: 
156: `make -C projects/app_ab clean`只删除`projects/app_ab/build`，不会删除
157: `build/openvela-ap.bin`。仅安装 Podman 时不要使用内部调用 Docker 的`dbuild.sh`。
158: 
159: ## 4. 构建验收
160: 
161: 以下文件必须都反映同一份 16 MiB 布局：
162: 
163: ```text
164: projects/app_ab/partitions/bk7258/ram_regions.csv
165: projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/partitions/ram_regions.h
166: projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/bk7258/armino/partitions/_build/ram_regions.csv
167: projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/bk7258_ap/armino/partitions/_build/ram_regions.csv
168: projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/bk7258/armino/bk7258/bk7258_out.ld
169: projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/bk7258_ap/armino/bk7258_ap/bk7258_ap_out.ld
170: ```
171: 
172: 关键值应为：
173: 
174: ```text
175: CONFIG_PSRAM_CAPACITY          0x01000000
176: CP_PSRAM_HEAP                 0x60700000 + 0x00020000
177: AP_PSRAM_HEAP                 0x60720000 + 0x002e0000
178: AP_PSRAM_SECTION              0x60a00000 + 0x00600000

188:   projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/package/tmp/app1.bin

205: 内存应以 `nuttx.map`或`System.map`为准。

207: ## 5. OpenVela PSRAM 接入状态
208: 
209: OpenVela AP侧已经完成以下代码和离线构建基线：
210: 
211: - 精确16 MiB、RW/XN/non-cacheable MPU映射。
212: - `0x60720000..0x609fffff`独立AP PSRAM heap。
213: - USER/AUDIO/ENCODE/DISPLAY四个独立媒体pool。

215: - AP owner区域保存/恢复型alias probe，包含4/8/12 MiB测试点。
216: - 当前SMP协议兼容的`0x7/0x8/0x9/0xa`PWC处理和PSRAM_REQUIRED ready门禁。
217: - `0x60a00000..0x60ffffff`静态section链接保留；reset copy/clear未实现前强制0 B。
218: 
219: 当前CP协议不通过`0xc`或其他命令暴露PSRAM initialized、device ID和actual capacity。
220: `0x7`响应只回显ON/OFF状态，不能单独证明PHY初始化成功或器件为16 MiB。因此当前

257: ## 7. UART0 Mailbox V2 使用和边界
258: 
259: CP 启动后默认 owner 为 `CP_CLI`。只有 MB_UART0 STATE 成功 ACK、IPC power-up 和
260: PWC boot-ready 三个条件同时成立，且`bk_mb_uart_write_ready()`非零时，
261: `ap_console open`才允许进入。heartbeat timeout、AP reset/power-off 和 Mailbox
262: reset/timeout都会清除门禁并请求回退到CP CLI。使用方式：
